title: Arbitrary unions of open substacks exist as open substacks
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Define X' as the fibred subcategory of objects x with coprod (X_i x_X T) -> T surjective; each X_i embeds via the section (x_i, 1); represent X' x_X T by the open union T_i of the opens representing X_i x_X T (the isomorphism f^*x ≃ y identifies the fibres, covering iff f lands in the union); conclude algebraic + open by the open-fibred-category lemma and read off the covering morphism from the cartesian squares.
